gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Wide, confident, almost shouting: Goldman spreads its round letters out like open parentheses. Noto Sans Medefaidrin follows with tall lowercase and curves that never clog, so a long passage keeps moving without any heaviness.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Goldman's lowercase towers over its capitals, a quirk you spot instantly. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek brings rounds that gap like a cracked bangle and large lowercase eyes, and that open, modern plain sans quality is what makes the pairing memorable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Goldman looks broad and bold, its letters spaced with real room between them. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui lets daylight through every curve, so a longer passage reads cleanly and with a tall, steady stride.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Goldman's round forms bend like open parentheses, set wide apart. Noto Sans Meroitic fills its lines with lowercase that stands nearly as large as capitals, so the heading's width meets a plain sans that looks just as generous.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi keeps daylight inside every curve and a small gap between capital and lowercase height. And next to Goldman's wide, commanding headings, that quiet openness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono gives every letter its own space. Beside Goldman's bold, widely set heading, that sturdy tall lowercase in a plain sans makes words look large and unmistakably readable, which is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs words dense and tall through the middle of each line, with wide entrances into every letter. Goldman does the commanding part, stretching its round, parenthesis-like forms wide, while Noto Sans Mro handles the steady work of the text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-multani: Commanding, wide and sure of itself, Goldman leads. Noto Sans Multani adds a lofty x-height and an e with a gap at its terminal, and that plain sans openness against the heading's bold width is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar forms a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle, with a c that opens broadly and welcomingly. Goldman's wide, bold letters echo that weight, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Commanding is Goldman's mood, with wide letters, generous clearance and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Noto Sans Nabataean follows with lowercase almost cap-tall and open s curves, so longer text moves smoothly.
